title: Finite Directional Coefficient Modules over Euler Fibers of $A$-Hypergeometric Systems
summary: Let \(A\) be a full-rank integer matrix, let \(β\) be a complex parameter, and consider the associated \(A\)-hypergeometric system. Without assuming homogeneity, pointedness, or positivity, we study directed formal logarithmic solutions over all exponent lattices in the Euler fiber. For a fixed lattice-generic direction, negative-support strata are described by rational sign polyhedra, and normalization reduces the coefficient equations on each exponent lattice to a finite directional coefficient module.
